channel.title: React Bits changelog
channel.description: Keep up with the newest additions to React Bits.

item.title: New: Flying Button
item.description: Button that fires its thrusters on hover, lifts off on a WebGL smoke plume and lands back in its own cloud.

item.title: New: Gradient ASCII
item.description: Soft gradient glows drawn in ASCII characters that scramble under the cursor.

item.title: Updated: Fluid Glass
item.description: Same look with less than half the GPU work. On high refresh rate screens it also draws fewer frames while the glass is at rest.

item.title: Updated: Acid Squares
item.description: Rebuilt as a rolling field of glossy squares under two drifting colored lights, with square ripples, film grain and an intro that switches the squares on from the center.

item.title: Updated: Ghost Fibers
item.description: Rebuilt as layered ribbons of fine glowing fibers with soft depth of field, bright folds and new looks to pick from.

item.title: Updated: Aero Shards
item.description: Rebuilt as silk ribbons of thick glass shards that stream smoothly on layered depths, light up along their edges and soften into the distance. Adds a chrome finish, survey markers, a cursor that parts the shards, a light wave on click, presets and an edge fade.

item.title: Updated: Blur Text
item.description: Text can now zoom, tilt in 3D, pull into focus or drift in, starting from the middle, the end or at random. It can also loop, replay on hover or click, start in a second color and keep the hovered word sharp.

item.title: Updated: Card Nav
item.description: Rebuilt with a springy open, cards that rise, unfold or fade in, sliding link arrows, open on hover, a stacked layout for small screens and a light mode.

item.title: Updated: Circular Text
item.description: Fling the ring and it coasts back to its cruising speed, leans toward the cursor in 3D and can sit back like a planet’s orbit. Add an icon in the middle, an inner circle and natural spacing with gaps.

item.title: Updated: Count Up
item.description: Numbers can roll into place like an odometer, settle with a spring, shorten to 1.2K or 3.4M and replay on hover.

item.title: Updated: Counter
item.description: Rebuilt with springy rolling digits, motion blur and a spin-in intro. Formats currency, percentages, separators and locales, and digits slide in and out as the number grows or shrinks.

item.title: Updated: CRT Warp
item.description: Rebuilt as a real CRT that warms up into view, with true scanlines, phosphor masks, afterglow and bloom. The cursor bends the picture like a magnet, clicks flip the channel, and presets add amber, green and arcade looks.

item.title: Updated: Curved Loop
item.description: Text can now travel along a wave, a closed ring or a straight line, with outlined letters and an accent mark between repeats. Scrolling the page gives the loop a burst of speed that eases off.

item.title: Updated: Decrypted Text
item.description: Letters can now roll in like a flip board or brighten out of faint glyphs, with an accent color that settles as they decode. Text can loop, and hovering can scramble just the letters near the cursor.

item.title: Updated: Depth Text
item.description: The extrusion can now fade into the page, and the word presses in on hover and springs back. It can also float gently while idle.

item.title: Updated: Echo Text
item.description: Click the text to send out a burst of echoes, or let the echoes drift on their own or trail behind page scrolling. Echoes can also fade between two colors.

item.title: Updated: Elastic Slider
item.description: Rebuilt with smoother springs and a rubber-band pull at both ends. Adds vertical and pill styles, icons and values inside the track, ticks, a handle, centered fills, and keyboard and scroll control.

item.title: Updated: Flowing Menu
item.description: Rebuilt around one liquid band that glides and stretches between rows and leans toward the cursor, with an intro sweep. New capsule and slab shapes, an editorial layout, notes per row and keyboard support.

item.title: Updated: Fold Text
item.description: Letters can now open like blinds or flip over like cards, and fold away near the cursor as it passes. Looping text can hold as long as you like before folding back up.

item.title: Updated: Fuzzy Text
item.description: Text can now resolve out of heavy static when it first appears and tear into soft color fringes. The fuzz can follow the cursor, run all the time or fire in bursts on click.

item.title: Updated: Glitch Text
item.description: Pick from four glitch styles: sliced bands, a jittering color split, a scanning tear or swapped glyphs. Set how hard it glitches, add skew and flicker, and play short bursts on click.

item.title: Updated: Gradient Waves
item.description: Waves are now lit with soft light and shadow, rise from calm water on load, catch a light that follows the cursor and roll a swell in on click. Adds light direction, presets, a light mode and no dependencies.

item.title: Updated: Image Trail
item.description: The eight fixed variants are now one trail you can tune: size, timing, zoom, flash, drift, tilt, rotation and a stacking pile. Four presets recreate the favourite looks.

item.title: Updated: Logo Loop
item.description: Now draggable with a soft fade that works on any background and an intro. Adds wave, arc and 3D orbit paths, a center lens, dock-style magnify, stepping, labels and perspective tilt.

item.title: Updated: Masked Heading
item.description: Two new entrances, letters growing in one by one and a focus pull, plus a soft light that follows the cursor and brings back full color. Letters can also be drawn as thin strokes that the image fills as it arrives.

item.title: Updated: Masonry
item.description: Rebuilt with springy reflow, tiles that appear as you scroll, hover zoom, lift and tilt, captions, a lightbox and drag to reorder. Columns now follow the container and tiles keep each image's shape.

item.title: Updated: Molten Metal
item.description: The metal now ignites from its white-hot cores, the cursor heats the filaments it passes and clicks flare them white-hot. Adds filament width, haze, rotation and position controls, more colors, crisper fine detail, a richer light mode and no dependencies.

item.title: Updated: Orbit Images
item.description: Rebuilt with real depth, so photos pass behind and in front of whatever sits in the middle, and it now fits any container. Drag to spin it, click a photo to bring it forward, and style the tiles, shadows and path.

item.title: Updated: Particle Text
item.description: Text can now rain in, swirl into place or print behind a sweeping line, and particles can be drawn as squares or short strokes. Click to blow the particles apart and watch them spring back.

item.title: Updated: Pill Nav
item.description: Rebuilt with a smoother rising fill and rolling labels, a sliding active dot, a gliding pill option, a menu that folds in on small screens, and a light mode.

item.title: Updated: Pixel Swap
item.description: Rebuilt to be fast and seamless, with pixels that spring in from wherever the cursor enters and retreat the moment it leaves. New dot and spin styles and a pixel intro.

item.title: Updated: Rotating Text
item.description: Words can now flip, blur, zoom or drop in with a small bounce, rolling up or down. A highlight block smoothly resizes to fit each word and keeps the text readable on any color.

item.title: Updated: Scrambled Text
item.description: Letters near the cursor can now rise, blur or swell like a lens, and a click sends a scramble wave through the text. Works with any typeface without the layout jumping.

item.title: Updated: Scroll Float
item.description: Letters can now flip, scatter, blur or wave into place, by letter or by word, from above or below. Pick which go first and let them arrive in an accent color.

item.title: Updated: Scroll Reveal
item.description: Text can now reveal by word, letter or line, rising, flipping or popping into place, and light up in an accent color as it appears. It can also play once on entering view.

item.title: Updated: Scroll Velocity
item.description: Rows can lean and stretch with scroll speed, be grabbed and thrown with inertia, and alternate with outlined text. Set the text size, weight, color and spacing directly.

item.title: Updated: Shuffle
item.description: Letters can now flip like cards in 3D or spin in place with motion blur, and hovering can reshuffle just the letters near the cursor. Adds text and accent colors and a motion blur for sliding letters, and up or left shuffles no longer land on random symbols.

item.title: Updated: Splash Cursor
item.description: Strokes now flow unbroken with smoothly shifting colors, clicks burst into a real splash, and it rests when idle. New ink, smoke, lava and silk looks, a soft glow and a light theme.

item.title: Updated: Split Flap Text
item.description: Boards can now cascade from the right, from the middle or in random order, with a soft sheen across falling flaps and adjustable depth. A new minimal style drops the tiles and flips bare characters split by a hinge line.

item.title: Updated: Split Text
item.description: Text can now flip, pop, blur, skew or wave into place, loop, and replay on hover or click. Pieces can arrive in an accent color, and letters lift or ripple under the cursor.

item.title: Updated: Strands
item.description: Rebuilt to match the new Siri orb: spectral strands twist inside frosted glass and swell into one smooth bulge where they come together. It livens up with a voice, a click or the cursor.

item.title: Updated: Stroke Text
item.description: Outlines can now be dashed or dotted and keep flowing around the letters, and they redraw when hovered. Filled letters can also lift off the page with a soft offset shadow.

item.title: Updated: Tech Text
item.description: Click a letter to ripple the word, play a typed, assembled or font metrics intro, and show the font’s guide lines.

item.title: Updated: Text Loop
item.description: Add a second band that crosses the first in an X with a soft shadow, drag or fling the loop, and let page scrolling speed it up or reverse it. Letters can now be drawn as outlines.

item.title: Updated: Text Pressure
item.description: Click to send a ripple of pressure through the letters, and let the word keep rolling or breathing while the cursor is away. Letters can warm toward an accent color as they swell, and you can set how softly they follow.

item.title: Updated: Text Type
item.description: Pick a bar, block or underscore cursor that glides and blinks softly, and let letters fade, blur or rise in as they type. Add occasional typos that get corrected, or a fixed lead-in before rotating words.

item.title: Updated: True Focus
item.description: Mark the focused word with a box, an underline or a soft highlight, and let it scale up slightly. The frame can spring between words and visit them in random order.

item.title: Updated: Variable Proximity
item.description: Letters can now shift toward an accent color, grow and rise as the cursor gets close, and a gentle wave of weight runs through the text while idle. Adds a font size setting, and lines no longer rewrap while letters change weight.

item.title: Updated: Warp Text
item.description: Clicking now sends a shockwave through the text, and the lens can keep wandering across the words when the cursor leaves. Adds glass-like color fringing inside the lens, with smoother fringe edges in light and dark mode.

item.title: Updated: Web Threads
item.description: Threads now draw in one after another, the strand under the cursor lights up while the rest recede, and clicks send light into the pinch. Adds braids, a 3D twist, traveling pulses, rotation, soft ends, more threads and colors, and a cleaner light mode.

item.title: Updated: Animated Content
item.description: Now with blur-in, rotate, 3D tilt and soft wipe reveals, staggered children for lists and grids, scroll-linked progress, replay on scroll and a mount trigger.

item.title: Updated: Antigravity
item.description: Rebuilt with crisp, colorful particles that swirl into a ring with springy motion and streak when they move fast. Hold to charge and release to burst, plus presets, a liftoff intro and a light mode.

item.title: Updated: Balatro
item.description: Rebuilt on the same swirl with crisp pixels and no extra dependencies. The cursor now stirs the paint, clicks spin up whirlpools, and an intro spins it into place.

item.title: Updated: Ballpit
item.description: Rebuilt for smooth physics that handles thousands of balls, with soft modern finishes, and you can now grab, throw and blast them apart.

item.title: Updated: Circular Gallery
item.description: Rebuilt with crisp, smooth edges and no extra dependencies. Cards now open to the full image, respond to hover and the keyboard, and the gallery can drift, snap, fade and change shape.

item.title: Updated: Click Spark
item.description: Sharper sparks with new shapes, colors, gravity and glow. Bursts can now spill past small buttons, appear behind your content, and fire from code.

item.title: Updated: Cursor Grid
item.description: Rebuilt as a crisp, minimal grid with a soft spotlight, single cell or area highlights, tiles, dashed, dot and mark styles, clean click rings, an intro and a light mode.

item.title: Updated: Dot Field
item.description: Rebuilt around a smooth magnifying lens that stays under the cursor and zooms closer while you hold. New dot layouts, swirl and pinch lenses, and an intro that pulls into focus.

item.title: Updated: Electric Border
item.description: Rebuilt with layered lightning strands, sparks and a soft glow. The current races around the edge as it powers on, surges near the cursor and jolts around on click, and now works in light mode.

item.title: Updated: Fade Content
item.description: Now fades in out of focus, from washed-out gray, or through grain, mist and pixel blocks, with staggered children and scroll-linked fades in and out.

item.title: Updated: Faulty Terminal
item.description: Same terminal, now with phosphor glow, trails under the cursor, glitches on click, a cleaner light mode and new dot and character glyphs. Around 4x faster.

item.title: Updated: Fluid Glass
item.description: Rebuilt as a real glass object that bends your own text, image or video, with no 3D models or extra dependencies. Seven shapes that melt into each other on click, plus frost, tint, dispersion and shadows.

item.title: Updated: Ghost Cursor
item.description: Rebuilt as real drifting smoke that stays sharp on any screen, many times faster and with no extra dependencies. Clicks release a puff, and it works on light pages too.

item.title: Updated: Gradient Blinds
item.description: Same blinds with satin shading that turns with the light, a soft glow, a gentle sway and a cleaner light mode. A click sends a wave of light through them, with no extra dependencies.

item.title: Updated: Gradual Blur
item.description: Smoother blur with no visible steps, plus a fade to any color, a color boost, hover to clear, and a blur that hides itself at the ends of a scroll.

item.title: Updated: Grainient
item.description: Rebuilt with richer colors, flowing waves and no extra dependencies. Drag the colors around or click to swirl them, and try stripes, rings, crisp poster edges or a satin sheen.

item.title: Updated: Grid Scan
item.description: Rebuilt as a lit 3D room with crisp lines, a glossy floor and sparkling scan points, with no extra dependencies. The view shifts like a window as you move, and clicks send a ping across the walls.

item.title: Updated: Letter Glitch
item.description: Redesigned as a crisp, calm field of letters that glitch in color, now much lighter to run. The cursor scrambles nearby letters, a click tears through the rows, and fonts, spacing and character sets are all adjustable.

item.title: Updated: Light Rays
item.description: Rebuilt on the same rays with a glowing source, drifting haze and crisper shafts, at a fraction of the cost. The cursor now casts a soft shadow and clicks send a wave of light down the beam.

item.title: Updated: Line Waves
item.description: Rebuilt with crisp, smoothly flowing lines and a soft band of light that drifts through them. Adds presets, a cursor spotlight, click ripples and a light mode.

item.title: Updated: Liquid Chrome
item.description: Rebuilt as soft, glossy liquid chrome whose reflections follow the cursor, with a liquid wake and ripples on click. Adds presets, a light mode and a faster renderer.

item.title: Updated: Liquid Ether
item.description: Rebuilt with smoother, glowing swirls, a sweeping intro and puffs on click. Runs several times faster and adds presets and a light mode.

item.title: Updated: Magic Bento
item.description: Redesigned with animated artwork in every card, smoother cursor light and a click wave across the grid. Cards now take your own content, photos and links, with dark and light themes.

item.title: Updated: Magic Rings
item.description: Rebuilt from scratch and moved to Backgrounds, lighter and about three times faster, with crisper lines and glow. Rings can now ripple, breathe, spin or lean in 3D, react to hover and clicks, split into prism fringes, and work in light mode.

item.title: Updated: Magnet
item.description: Now moves on a real spring with a smooth pull at the edge of its range, and only the nearest magnet reacts when several overlap. Adds tilt, scale, axis locking and a movement cap.

item.title: Updated: Magnet Lines
item.description: Now a background that fills its container, with the square still available. Lines swing on springs, ripple out from the cursor and spin with each click, with new field modes, arrow and compass shapes, and a 3D tilt.

item.title: Updated: Pixel Blast
item.description: Same pixel clouds, now smoother and softer, with drift, shimmer, glow, an accent color, a blast intro and a cursor that lights pixels up. New shapes and a perspective floor, much faster, no dependencies.

item.title: Updated: Prism
item.description: Same glowing prism, now several times faster with no extra dependencies. It tilts toward the cursor, fades in, takes custom colors, and has a cleaner light mode and a working 3D rotation.

item.title: Updated: Reflective Card
item.description: Rebuilt as a satin metal card that reflects a looping video until you turn the camera on. It tilts toward the cursor, catches a sweeping light and comes in dark and light themes.

item.title: Updated: Scanner
item.description: Crisper glowing lines and a scan head with an afterglow trail, plus lines that part around the cursor, click pings, a power-on intro and a light mode.

item.title: Updated: Side Rays
item.description: Rebuilt with soft, shimmering light shafts that grow in from the corner and lean toward the cursor. Adds presets, side origins, drifting dust and a light mode.

item.title: Updated: Soft Aurora
item.description: The band now reaches toward a nearby cursor, clicks send a pulse of light along it, and it blooms in from a thin line. New presets, a tilt and a cleaner light mode, with no extra dependencies.

item.title: Updated: Sticker Peel
item.description: Rebuilt with a real curl, soft shadows and no extra dependencies. The edge nearest the cursor lifts, thrown stickers swing, slide and bounce, and there are gloss, matte and holographic finishes.

item.title: Updated: Swarm Cursor
item.description: Rebuilt as a liquid swarm that flows after the cursor, curls into eddies when you stop, pours around hovered buttons and splashes on click. No extra dependencies.

item.title: Updated: Tilted Card
item.description: Rebuilt with springy motion, glare, a soft shadow and floating depth layers, and no extra dependencies. Cards now flip to a back side, work with touch and phone tilt, and come with album, gallery and ticket demos.

item.title: Updated: Topography
item.description: Rebuilt as a 3D landscape of glowing contour lines that rises from a flat map, with land that lifts under the cursor, click pulses, optional survey markers and glitches, and a light mode.

item.title: New: Flux Lines
item.description: Glowing flux lines tracing a churning magnetic fluid.

item.title: Updated: Aurora
item.description: Rebuilt with smoother, richer color blending and a softer edge that never bands. It reaches gently toward the cursor, fades in on load, and can rise from the bottom or stack extra layers.

item.title: Updated: Dither
item.description: Rebuilt on the same waves with crisp pixels and no extra dependencies. New dither patterns, retro palettes, cursor trails and click ripples, and an intro that sharpens into place.

item.title: Updated: Falling Text
item.description: Rebuilt with smoother physics. Words or single letters knock each other loose as they fall, can be thrown and swept around, and fly back into place, with a new tiles style and light mode.

item.title: Updated: Ferrofluid
item.description: Rebuilt as a glossy ferrofluid sea with no extra dependencies. Swells of spikes roll across it, the cursor raises a crown and clicks send out a ring of spikes.

item.title: Updated: Floating Lines
item.description: Redrawn with crisp, finely glowing lines and no extra dependencies. The lines part smoothly around the cursor, curl when clicked, and come in dotted and dashed styles with a clean ink light mode.

item.title: Updated: Galaxy
item.description: Rebuilt with no extra dependencies. Stars now glide away from the cursor, a click jumps to warp speed and it arrives from hyperspace. New star colors, flares, depth and a cleaner light mode.

item.title: Updated: Light Pillar
item.description: Rebuilt to run about four times faster with the same look. It now ignites on load, follows the cursor, surges on click and has a soft glow, presets and more controls.

item.title: Updated: Light Tunnel
item.description: Redesigned with fine glowing fibres and comet-like pulses, and no extra dependencies. The cursor steers the tunnel, a click sends a ring of light down it, and light mode draws it in ink.

item.title: Updated: Lightfall
item.description: Rebuilt with crisp, steady streaks and round glowing heads. The light now warps in on load, bends around the cursor and stretches into warp trails while you hold.

item.title: Updated: Orb
item.description: Rebuilt with a crisper, more luminous ring that reaches toward the cursor and lights up where you hover. It pulses on click, powers on with an intro, and can tilt in 3D with custom colors, size and glow.

item.title: Updated: Particles
item.description: Rebuilt with the same floating motion, now crisp and far faster with thousands of particles. New shapes, glow, twinkle, bokeh, constellation lines, drifting and cursor effects.

item.title: Updated: Pixel Card
item.description: Rebuilt with crisp pixels and a glowing reveal wave that can start from the cursor. It can run on hover, click or always on, with an edge fade that keeps card content readable.

item.title: Updated: Prismatic Burst
item.description: Runs up to four times faster with the same look, and adds spirals, flowing color and finer control over the rays. The burst now ignites on load, leans toward the cursor and sends a wave of light outward on click.
